headline: Weathered Expanse Swings to Wardens as Marban Hollow Burns On
war_summary: The last edition's ledger is overturned in the north: Weathered Expanse, four Colonial works to three Warden when this desk last wrote, now stands six Warden against a single Colonial hold, two strongpoints unclaimed and twenty-nine events logged across the day. Its ground remains the war's costliest, with roughly eleven thousand Colonial and thirteen thousand Warden casualties in twenty-four hours. Linn Mercy has gone comparatively quiet, no ownership actions in two hours and the latest at Outwich Ranch, yet its casualty rolls still mount faster than any other sector, some seventeen hundred Colonial and thirty-five hundred Warden in that same brief span. Marban Hollow is the day's busiest field, Checkpoint Bua alone accounting for thirty-three events; Palantine Berm, sixty-one events in a day, holds four Warden posts to three Colonial, with Vendett and Windburn Landing the points of contention. Gutter's Suojus and Lost Kaivo changed hands repeatedly, leaving six Warden works to one Colonial. Fresh actions were also reported at Stonecradle's The Dais and Farranac Coast's Transient Valley. Thirty-four towns are still required for victory.
